- README "Installation" clones `https://git.ardenone.com/jedarden/pose-detection.git`. 1. README Installation: switch to `git clone https://github.com/jedarden/pose-detection.git`. Keep the prerequisites above the first command. State the first result literally: `npm run dev` serves http://localhost:5173; the browser asks for the camera; allow it and the skeleton overlay appears.

  ```bash
  set -euo pipefail
  mkdir -p ~/scratch && d=$(mktemp -d ~/scratch/stranger-pose.XXXXXX)
  trap 'rc=$?; kill "${dev:-}" 2>/dev/null || true; docker rm -f pose-stranger >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then rm -rf "$d"; else echo "kept $d for diagnosis" >&2; fi' EXIT
  cd "$d" && git clone https://github.com/jedarden/pose-detection.git && cd pose-detection
  # From here, ONLY commands copied from README.md

  npm run dev -- --port 5173 & dev=$!
  for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS http://localhost:5173/ | grep -q 'id="root"' && break; sleep 2; done
  docker build -t pose-detection:stranger . && docker run -d --name pose-stranger -p 18080:8080 pose-detection:stranger
  for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS http://localhost:18080/ | grep -q 'id="root"' && break; sleep 2; done
  ```

- `npx vitest run` and `npm run build` still pass.
- No `.github/workflows/*` is created.

- The root declutter (the blocking bead).
- Kubernetes examples (posedete-ca19b28e).
- Delivering or descoping Motion Tracking (posedete-5f76fd29).
- The PWA/service-worker proposals.
- GitHub topics (already 8).
